note: The audit's 16-dimension grid, as data (docs/AGENT_DESIGN.md §3 Q5, C7). `verdict` is the density tier (DENSE|MODERATE|THIN|EMPTY); `data_blocked` and `out_of_scope` are separate flags so a compound label like 'EMPTY + DATA-BLOCKED' or 'MODERATE / partly DATA-BLOCKED' in the audit's prose becomes two clean fields instead of a string to parse. `tests` lists real `test_id`s from src/analysis/tests.py, verified by src/analysis/coverage_register.py's verify_register() (tests/test_coverage_register.py runs it in CI on every push). `hypotheses` are INVESTIGATIONS.md entry numbers (informational only — not machine-checked; that file is gitignored). Updated by: Refiner on codification, Researcher via pending-merges proposing new rows, read by Explorer at Stage 2 (both integrations are docs/AGENT_DESIGN.md §6 Step 5, not built yet).

dimensions.name: Procurement integrity (threshold-gaming, supplier capture, decider–supplier links)
dimensions.tradition: OAG (its first LG performance audit) · ICAC/IBAC grammar · Part 3.3
dimensions.notes: Notably two-sided: four converging clean nulls are published as supportive credits. procurement.single_source is a placeholder generator (always data_ok=false on this corpus) not listed in the audit's own prose table.

dimensions.name: Power structure & factional capture
dimensions.tradition: Perth Inquiry root-cause genre · Part 3.2 · Carpenter/Moss capture

dimensions.name: Elected-vs-administrative locus (principal–agent, officer capture, delegation)
dimensions.tradition: Principal–agent · Part 3.2 "visible contest is theatre" · Golden Triangle
dimensions.notes: One shipped test; the deeper questions ([32] committee-vs-chamber, [43] CEO-era discontinuity) died structurally — the corpus sees the chamber, not the administration, a hard limit of minutes as a source.

dimensions.name: Chamber renewal & incumbency
dimensions.notes: Mostly neutral/descriptive — appropriate for this dimension.

dimensions.name: Citizen-input responsiveness (questions, deputations, petitions, objections)
dimensions.notes: The only fire-alarm channel in an otherwise pure police-patrol battery; petition outcomes ([38]) are data-blocked at the hypothesis level (no register row of its own — tracked in pipeline/DATA_ENRICHMENT.md).

dimensions.name: Economy / value-for-money (spending discipline, timing, waste)
dimensions.tradition: ISSAI 300 economy/efficiency · OAG financial audits · Part 3.1
dimensions.notes: One test, all nulls; the corpus records decisions to spend, not costs or unit prices.

dimensions.name: Financial sustainability (reserves, debt, structural balance, capitalisation dependency)
dimensions.tradition: The core of the intervention literature (Caller report; s.114 wave) · Part 3.1/3.6/3.7/3.9
dimensions.notes: Headline finding (F2/F3): reserve/debt trajectories aren't reliably in minutes — they live in annual financial statements, budgets, and OAG results, a different document class from the same institution. finance.reserve_trajectory is a placeholder generator (always data_ok=false on this corpus), not a real signal yet. [24] parked.

dimensions.name: Programme effectiveness (did declared interventions achieve their stated purpose?)
dimensions.tradition: ISSAI 300 effectiveness · UK VFM arrangements duty · CIPFA C/D · Part 3.5
dimensions.notes: In progress — taxonomy (3.5) and Dimension 1 domain F already exist; [46] is a first attempt (Session 11), methodology needs tightening; no shipped test yet.

dimensions.name: Gifts, benefits & post-separation relationships
dimensions.tradition: OAG audited exactly this, LG-wide · ICAC
dimensions.notes: Likely partly data-blocked (gift registers are usually separate documents), but acceptances/hospitality do surface in minutes — a hypothesis seed costs one Explorer slot to establish whether Cambridge's do.

dimensions.name: Records & recordkeeping quality
dimensions.tradition: OAG (a full LG performance audit topic) · VAGO/IBAC "poor records are themselves an indicator"
dimensions.notes: Reframe opportunity (F4): the pipeline's own extraction caveats (split identities, NULL rates, missing values — now computed by council profile / src/analysis/profile.py, docs/AGENT_DESIGN.md §6 Step 3) are currently internal apologies; under this dimension they're a publishable finding about the council's records.

dimensions.name: Distributive equity (do benefits/attention track power or geography?)
dimensions.notes: Plausibly feasible: planning applications and works tenders carry locations. The strongest layman-relevant empty row — "does my end of the district get anything?"

dimensions.name: Asset management
dimensions.notes: Valuations/renewals live in annual statements, not minutes.

dimensions.name: Service performance (are the services any good?)
dimensions.notes: Needs data external to any document corpus. Named as a scope boundary, not silently absent (coverage audit Recommendation 2).
